scope.method: Static source/README/acceptance inspection only. No owner module imports/functions, tests, runtime variants, process observations/control or frontend edits. Only this report created.
scope.data_boundary: No numeric label/source-value packets, prediction/posterior banks or supplied-result files opened. Numbers in acceptance/README/profile prose were not recomputed.
scope.verification_scope: Direct bindings among inspected metadata/code/docs verified; no recursive data/posterior replay. Prior v3 pair/chamber audit retained without repetition.

current_evidence.acceptance: Implemented evaluation interfaces accepted using bounded synthetic/source/supplied-reader checks only.
current_evidence.run_state: No completed actual posterior/forecast at checkpoint issuance. Startup/constructor/progress is separate from qualification.

request.comparison: Accepted source/count/label/pair request: corrected A2022 V2, other registered cycles V1.

states.scored: Complete defined distribution and observed pair share.
states.label_missing: Defined summary, shape and leading probability remain; score null.
states.undefined_predictive_mass: Positive missing mass withholds full summary, score, shape and leading probability; no reweighting.

named_pair_uncertainty.aggregation: equal_cycles(reports) carries expected/provided/missing_cycles, complete_cycles and equal-cycle means. Incomplete complete-tier summaries remain null. Skill uses ratios/differences of same-set aggregate losses, never averages of race-relative ratios.
semantics: Share = first/(first+second) on exact ordered named endpoints, not all-candidate share. Signed pair margin = 200*share-100 percentage points.
Leading event is strictly share>.5, ties false with separate tie probability; legal_winner_probability=null. Never relabel as legal winner, ranked final winner or chamber event.
Common competitive subset frozen from F leading probability inclusive [.2,.8] before labels. Near50 [.4,.6] does not imply narrow: retain <=2pp and >=10pp margin probabilities.

Intervals are weighted empirical inverse-CDF central 50/80/95% ranges. Display coverage alongside width and nominal level. Coverage is retrospective frequency, not confidence in a forecast or numerical result.
Uniform[0,1] reference is the same pair-share target; always-.5 reference is the same pair-leading event. Neither is a count/legal-winner reference.
Null log loss with infinite flag/count is infinite empirical loss, not missing observation, zero or a clipped finite loss.

Native share CRPS/WIS/absolute error/width units are share fractions; explicit x100 yields percentage points. Pair-margin fields are already percentage points. Binary Brier and natural-log losses are dimensionless, not points.

joint_energy.optional_arms: include_baselines=false omits F/FP; render not requested, never zero energy.
semantics: Proper whole ordered named-pair share-vector score, lower is better; native share-fraction units with fixed sqrt(races) scaling. Optional x100 conversion must be explicit. Not a scalar-race loss or sum of component effects.
Retains complete common parent/chain/draw rows and actual original weights, all ordered pairs and diagonal; no independent column shuffle, race drop or reweighting.
Any undefined required observed coordinate or positive-weight predictive vector withholds whole score.

Same-vector/outcome differences can be descriptively compared despite different inputs, but do not identify polling/population/component effects, exhaustively diagnose dependence or certify precision.
No full-size archived baseline energy in accepted evidence. Equal-cycle means require both registered tier cycles and every arm score; no missing-cycle substitution.

current_coverage_from_acceptance.rendering: Snapshot counts only. Derive cycle labels, expected event roster, observed/scored/omitted totals from authenticated selected manifests, never hardcode.

effect_semantics: One fresh Normal(0,.03) release effect per common row shared across target states/events; never reuse training release.
A2018/B2020 state_effect_source=fresh_normal_prior (per-state Normal(0,.05)); A2022/B2024=same_row_posterior. Same native/count row, original parents and masses retained.
Mean is expected event intensity*exp(release+state-(.03^2+.05^2)/2), NB alpha100. Never substitute realized physical participants, candidate sums or posterior means.
Inactive event: count/mean null and event_present=false. Active zero report is different. Hypothetical runoff predictions do not assert published runoff reports.
profile_quality: 2018 release_id=EAVS2018_state_briefs_F1a_snapshot: reported participating voters across modes; rejected provisional participation only when credited in voter history, varying reporting bases.
Later profile is counted-ballot voter report; cross-year definition equivalence is unvalidated. Keep 2018 profile distinct in shared reports.
Delaware general and Mississippi runoff lack 2018 labels; preserve full source/prediction roster, not only scored keys.
Individual 2018 brief publication/revision and within-state completeness remain unknown; do not substitute general dataset release dates.
Texas published F1a disagrees with its own mode subtotal and accepted Senate vote total. Preserve original observation and discrepancy flags without replacing it.
Source variance null is unknown, not zero. Error scales and definition transfer are uncalibrated working assumptions.
These are reported administrative totals, not exact physical-participant truth, eligible population, contest marks or all valid votes.
score_semantics: CRPS/WIS/absolute error/width in report-count units, not share points. Negative natural-log predictive probability is dimensionless.
Log score uses weighted conditional NB100 mixture over latent/effect rows, not simulated exact-match frequencies. Extra effect/noise simulation error remains.
Positive undefined event mass withholds score without reweighting; zero predictive probability retains null loss plus infinite flag.

Output reports contains only labelled bound events. missing_source_table=false means at least one label, not complete source coverage. No aggregate report skill/cross-cycle score or precision certificate supplied.

orthogonal_statuses: execution: supplied/synthetic versus actual conditional posterior
unified_browser_requirements.matching_policy: Permit explicitly descriptive deltas when metric, ordered target, denominator, event/date, observed source/view, subset and aggregation match. Different information does not automatically hide comparisons; disclose it. Component attribution needs separately selected matched-ablation evidence. Incompatible/missing target/outcome withholds its comparison.
bindings: Authenticate result/request/source/registry/reader pins server-side before DTO projection; browser declarations do not authenticate artifacts.

Carry dynamic cycle/tier, literal cutoff/horizon/date, context, count/report artifact, pair-spec/design hash, ordered endpoint IDs and verified display names, estimand/denominator and source label view; corrected A2022 uses accepted V2.

Metric ID, native units, display scale, direction, quantile/interval convention, exact ordered subset and weighting. Do not collapse report counts, pair losses, legal-winner losses and vector energy into one unlabelled ranking.
coverage_missingness: Dynamic expected/bound/predicted/observed/scored/matched totals by arm/subset, omitted IDs/reasons, outside-roster identities and missing cycles. No hardcoded 97, 113 or four-cycle assumption.
Missing, undefined, unavailable, infinite and not-requested stay distinct. Tiny positive undefined mass must not display as 0%; no successful-row reweighting or missing-as-zero.

Partial available-case means are explicitly partial. Comparative aggregate deltas need identical scored ID sets/outcomes/weights; complete-subset/equal-cycle summaries remain withheld if required cells absent.
plain_language: CRPS is full-distribution error; WIS is range error balancing width with misses. Lower losses are better; name units. Explain mean/median and coverage numerator/denominator with nominal interval level.
Near-even leading probability may describe a wide or bimodal forecast. Prediction ranges are possible outcomes, not calculation error bars.
Reported administrative totals retain exact profile definition and source limitations; they do not directly validate physical turnout.
unified_browser_requirements.precision: Require authenticated metric-specific precision evidence or label unavailable. No race-iid error bars, cross-cycle significance, empirical calibration or qualification inferred from accepted tests or energy.
unified_browser_requirements.report_metadata_join: Score output alone lacks complete expected/missing source roster, profile/revision/TX flags and explicit retained/prior effect summary. Project selected configuration, profile acceptance, source quality and prediction provenance alongside scores.

private_pair_preview_boundary.compatible: Explicit denominator, unknown mass, unavailable scores, dynamic coverage and differing-input caution remain sound.
private_pair_preview_boundary.not_real_adapter: Invented-fixture-only candidate_marks/H14/three-arm parser; do not feed real research JSON directly or relax it into a universal scorer parser.
missing_sections: orthogonal actual-run/empirical/precision status and authenticated export
private_pair_preview_boundary.integration: Separate future reviewed projection and private renderer extension. Leave CountView/ElectionOutcomePreview, old fixture parser and public defaults untouched. No owner-frozen browser contract established.

safe_followups: Specify a versioned renderer projection of accepted outputs with bindings, units, masks and orthogonal statuses; no new discretionary scorer/runtime variant.
Once assigned, use invented fixtures for missing/infinite/undefined/event absence and matched-outcome/different-input comparisons.
When qualified saved results exist, bind exact root-selected outputs/precision evidence server-side. Rendering never triggers fits, report draws, energy recomputation or qualification.

verification.method: Exact path/SHA comparisons for references to files in source_pins; all matched. No transitive data replay or numeric evaluation.

changes_since_readiness_v3: Accepted useful-uncertainty output adds same-pair leading events, margin shape, coverage-width, competitive and equal-cycle summaries.
Accepted energy output adds complete-vector scoring with original joint-row dependence, separate from race losses and component attribution.

Accepted report prediction/scoring profile now connects 203 sourced administrative reports, including 50 original 2018 participating-voter reports; the earlier missing-2018 statement in predecessor selection/README is superseded only by explicit V2 profile acceptance.
No real browser export or public/empirical qualification follows; existing pair/chamber identities and private preview are not reimplemented.
